scope: Current task-level factual package for the Varrock Achievement Diary. It proposes future normalized actions and graph edges only. It does not edit production data, duplicate canonical Museum/Kudos, Digsite pendant, balloon, Skull sceptre, or transport records, assign strategy scores, or generate a route.

included: quest, skill, location, minigame, account, and encounter gates

source_catalog.use: Current task list, direct requirements, stated boostability, and tier rewards.
Current all-diary rules and requirement cross-check.
Task-specific cross-checks, alternatives, and non-boostable exceptions.
Live Varrock armour, lamp, battlestaff, GE-teleport, Cooks' Guild, and Skull sceptre reward effects.
50 and 153 Kudos thresholds and their concrete Museum utility.
Stronghold component chain, random-drop boundary, teleport, charge caps, and recharge facts.
Varrock armour 4 replacement effect for the Prospector jacket.
Edgeville furnace double-bar effect by Varrock armour tier.
Official approval record for the Medium-diary Varrock Teleport Grand Exchange toggle.
Original official Varrock Diary release context; current live mechanics are taken from the Wiki sources above.

global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any order.
global_rules.tier_claim: Claiming a tier requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy a task skill requirement unless the task explicitly marks a requirement not boostable or the requirement is an access/equipment condition that inherently checks the base level.
global_rules.proposed_task_transition: A successful task action adds only its durable Varrock diary task milestone. It never infers a variable drop, crop/plant lifecycle, combat win, Stronghold traversal, quest completion, daily reset, spellbook state, or existing transport availability.

do_not_duplicate: existing standard, Ancient, Lunar, spirit-tree, canoe, and Cooks' Guild transport/access facts
existing_normalization_reference.boundary: This package links diary task or tier milestones to existing canonical systems during integration; it does not replace their costs, cooldowns, locations, charge behavior, or quest records.

proposed_normalization.action_convention: For every task id T, propose action:complete-varrock-T. Each action has one non-repeatable milestone milestone:varrock-T-complete and records only the verified diary interaction. Actions that depend on encounters, follower state, Stronghold traversal, farming lifecycle, variables, or an already-modeled system must require observation/player confirmation rather than manufacture completion.
edge_patterns: required skill, quest, item, location, state, or existing canonical capability -> task action (requires)
all same-tier task milestones plus preceding claimed tier -> tier claim action (requires)
tier claim action -> tier node, armour, antique lamp entitlement, and listed tier-specific capability nodes (produces)
existing Museum/Kudos, Digsite pendant, balloon, Spirit tree, canoe, spellbook, and Skull sceptre nodes -> relevant task actions (references only; do not duplicate their implementation)
proposed_normalization.lamp_boundary: Every tier claim creates a fixed player-chosen lamp entitlement. The integrator must not choose a recipient skill or convert it into immediate skill XP without explicit account input.
state_boundaries: Daily Zaff purchase availability and the chosen daily battlestaff quantity need a daily/cooldown state model; tier claims grant only the purchase capability.
Armour mining and Edgeville-smelting effects are probabilistic modifiers; no ore/bar is created by the claim action.
Kudos is a permanent counter owned by existing Museum actions. This package only requires its observed value for the two diary tasks.
Canoe, balloon, Digsite pendant, Spirit tree, spellbook, and Skull sceptre charge states remain owned by their existing models.
Stronghold traversal, fishing/mining success, fruit availability, yew-root count, and range-baked summer-pie success are player-confirmed or stochastic boundaries.

task_fields_present: consumed, reusable, optional, and state-bound inputs
intentionally_not_modeled_as_actions: Skull sceptre component drops, bone-fragment yields, and charge mutations

conflicts_and_unknowns.resolution: Older official release material describes easy/medium armour as coal/mithril. The live rewards page reports gold/lovakite respectively, and this package uses the current live values. Hard remains up to adamantite and elite covers any qualifying ore, with exceptions.

The old 2015 reward announcement said the Easy diary unlocked the furnace. The furnace is now generally accessible; the live diary reward is the armour's conditional double-bar chance at that furnace, so no furnace-access node is proposed.
Some Wiki reward text reports Grand Exchange resale profit. That is not a valid Ironman economic benefit and is deliberately excluded from the package's utility claims.
Existing production records already model Museum sources and exact counter changes. The 50- and 153-Kudos diary tasks reference that canonical counter rather than offer a second progression path.

The cape has a 66 Hunter equipment requirement, but Ironmen need 69 Hunter to personally catch dashing kebbits for the two required furs. Both facts are retained without assuming an acquisition method for non-Ironmen.

The source explicitly keeps the Medium task at 20 mahogany logs regardless of vouchers. For the Elite Lunar task, the current diary page says ten vouchers can halve the required plank, coin, and rune inputs; integration should source-check the precise spell transaction implementation before emitting state transitions.
The package does not auto-complete a fishing/mining action, Stronghold traversal, crop harvest, or potential range-bake burn. These require observed success or a dedicated simulation model.
